title: Run a Deep Research Agent Task
description: Use an AI agent (Perplexity Deep Research or ChatGPT Tasks) to conduct a multi-step research task autonomously and evaluate the results.
steps: Define a research question that requires 5+ sources (e.g. "What are the main approaches to no-code AI automation in 2025?")
Submit it to Perplexity Deep Research or a similar agent tool
Let it run autonomously — do not interrupt
When it finishes, evaluate: did it answer the question? Were sources legitimate? Were any claims suspicious?
Fact-check 5 specific claims from the report
expectedOutput: A research report plus your own evaluation of agent quality, source quality, and hallucination rate.
bonusChallenges: Have the agent research the same topic as a previous manual research task — compare quality and time
Ask the agent to evaluate its own confidence in each section
